name: Chicken Sarnie with Apple Coleslaw
method: Spread the bread with the butter, put the salad leaves on two slices and lay the chicken on top.
Mix the grated carrot and apple with the yoghurt and pile it on the chicken.
Sandwich with the remaining bread and cut in half. If you are not eating it straight away, wrap it and keep it chilled, and serve with the cherry tomatoes and celery.
